summary: Planned the plugin scaffold, MCP boundary, list/editor, diff and final confirmations, save verification, drafts, responsive styling, unit tests, mock-MCP browser evidence, and live read-only check.

state.request: Build a dedicated Factory Souls BB panel that lists every Empirical Factory bot's soul, opens one in an editable monospace view, shows the bot's read-only tool list from factory_status, and saves only after a diff confirmation and a typed bot-name plus acknowledgment confirmation with an author. Use the Factory MCP stdio tools factory_souls, factory_soul_set (requires author), factory_soul_audit, and factory_status only; never factory_ticket, factory_message, board, ticket, message, or storage access. After save, re-read souls and audit and show the newest audit row. Keep a local unsaved draft across navigation, label it unsaved, and handle Factory not running with the start command.

sizeDecision.reason: The list, editor, draft, confirmation, save verification, and audit proof share one MCP boundary, one panel state machine, and one test harness. Shipping only part would leave a data-loss or unverified-write surface; keep one cohesive plugin.
